source: Can you send me the slides before the meeting starts?
target: Will you deliver the slides to me before the meeting begins?

source: I haven't finished the budget report yet, but I will by Thursday.
target: The budget report remains unfinished. It will be complete by Thursday.

source: Please don't schedule anything for me on Friday afternoon.
target: Leave my Friday afternoon untouched. Arrange nothing in it on my behalf.

source: Ravi is leading the client call today instead of Meera.
target: Ravi will lead the client call today. Meera will not.

source: If the server goes down again, call the support team immediately.
target: Should the server fail once more, summon the support team without delay.

source: Sorry, I sent the wrong version of the contract this morning.
target: I sent the wrong version of the contract this morning. For that, I apologise.

source: Thank you for covering my shift last week.
target: You held my shift last week in my absence. I am grateful.

source: The new hire starts on Monday at 9 am, not Tuesday.
target: The new hire begins on Monday at nine in the morning, not Tuesday.

source: We can't approve the leave request until the manager signs it.
target: The leave request cannot be granted until the manager has signed it. No signature, no approval.

source: Who is taking notes in today's meeting?
target: Who will record the notes in today's meeting?

source: I will finish the presentation tonight, even if it takes until midnight.
target: The presentation will be finished tonight, even should it demand every hour until midnight.

source: The printer on the third floor is out of toner and won't print.
target: The printer on the third floor has exhausted its toner. It will print nothing.

source: Sofia asked for two more days because she hasn't finished reviewing the proposal.
target: Sofia has requested two more days. Her review of the proposal is not yet finished.

source: Let's move the standup to 10:30 so everyone can attend.
target: Move the standup to ten-thirty. Then all may attend.

source: The meeting ran long, but we agreed on the next steps.
target: The meeting stretched beyond its hour, yet the next steps were settled.

source: Don't reply to the client until legal has checked the email.
target: Send no reply to the client until legal has examined the email. Not a word before.

source: Daniel didn't get the invitation for the training session.
target: The invitation to the training session never reached Daniel.

source: Could you check whether the invoice was paid?
target: Will you determine whether the invoice has been paid?

source: We need at least five people to run the workshop.
target: The workshop demands no fewer than five people. With fewer, it cannot run.

source: I'm not sure the deadline is realistic.
target: I am uncertain the deadline can be met. Its realism remains in question.

source: Please add Aisha to the project channel.
target: Bring Aisha into the project channel.

source: The office will be closed on the 15th for maintenance.
target: The office will stand closed on the fifteenth for maintenance. No one will work there that day.

source: I will review your code after lunch.
target: Your code will receive my scrutiny once lunch is done.

source: Unless the client objects, we'll ship the update on Wednesday.
target: Unless the client raises an objection, the update ships on Wednesday. Only an objection will halt it.

source: Tom wants the summary in one page, not five.
target: Tom demands the summary in a single page, not five. Brevity is required.

source: I apologise for interrupting you during the presentation.
target: I interrupted you during the presentation. I offer my apology.

source: The quarterly targets were missed by a small margin.
target: The quarterly targets were missed, though only by a narrow margin. A miss nonetheless.

source: Can we postpone the review to next week?
target: May the review be deferred until next week?

source: The team prefers short meetings rather than long email threads.
target: The team favours brief meetings over lengthy email threads. Speak briefly rather than write at length.

source: I won't be able to join the dinner after the conference.
target: I will not be present at the dinner that follows the conference. Do not expect me there.

source: Priya has already booked the conference room for 2 pm.
target: Priya has already secured the conference room for two in the afternoon.

source: If you finish early, help Leo with the testing.
target: Should your work conclude early, lend your hands to Leo's testing.

source: The draft is good, but the conclusion needs more evidence.
target: The draft is sound, yet its conclusion lacks sufficient evidence. Strengthen it.

source: Nobody told me the launch was cancelled.
target: The cancellation of the launch was never made known to me. No one spoke of it.

source: Please submit your timesheets by 5 pm on Friday.
target: Submit your timesheets by five in the afternoon on Friday. Not a minute later.

source: We hired three engineers this quarter, not four.
target: Three engineers joined us this quarter, not four. The count is three.

source: Thanks for explaining the new process so clearly.
target: You laid out the new process with great clarity. I thank you.

source: I'll send the minutes once everyone has reviewed them.
target: The minutes will be sent once every person has reviewed them. Not before.

source: Why was the release delayed again?
target: For what reason has the release been delayed once more?

source: The client liked the design but wants a darker colour.
target: The client approves of the design, yet desires a darker colour.

source: Don't share the salary figures with anyone outside HR.
target: The salary figures stay within HR. Share them with no one beyond it.

source: Meera will cover for me while I'm on leave.
target: Meera will stand in my place while I am on leave.

source: The laptop allowance is 60,000 rupees per employee.
target: Each employee is granted sixty thousand rupees for a laptop. That is the allowance.

source: We should test it on a small group before rolling it out.
target: Test it on a small group first. Only then roll it out to all.

source: I didn't mean to sound rude in that email.
target: Rudeness was never my intent in that email.

source: If the numbers don't match, flag it to finance.
target: Should the numbers fail to agree, bring the matter to finance. Do not let it pass unspoken.

source: I'll be working from home on Tuesday and Wednesday.
target: On Tuesday and Wednesday, I will work from my home. The office will not see me those days.

source: Could you introduce me to the new marketing lead?
target: Will you introduce me to the new head of marketing?

source: Although the project is behind schedule, the quality is excellent.
target: The project lags behind its schedule, yet its quality is excellent.

source: I promise to have the figures ready before the board meeting.
target: You have my word: the figures will be ready before the board convenes.

source: The interview is at 11 am, so I'll be offline for an hour.
target: The interview is set for eleven in the morning. For one hour, I will be beyond reach.

source: Please don't forward this message to the whole department.
target: Do not forward this message to the entire department. Its reach must stay narrow.

source: I'm sorry the report was late; the data arrived only yesterday.
target: The report came late, for the data arrived only yesterday. I offer my apology.

source: Aisha thinks we need a bigger budget, but I disagree.
target: Aisha holds that a larger budget is needed. I do not share her view.

source: Is the training mandatory for contractors too?
target: Does the training bind contractors as well?

source: We will hire a designer if the funding is approved.
target: Should the funding be approved, a designer will be hired. Not before.

source: The CEO is visiting our branch next Thursday.
target: Next Thursday, the CEO will come to our branch.

source: I can't access the shared drive from my new laptop.
target: The shared drive refuses me from my new laptop. Access is denied.

source: Let's not decide anything until Ravi is back.
target: Decide nothing until Ravi has returned. The decision waits for him.

source: Thank you for staying late to fix the bug.
target: You remained late to mend the bug. You have my thanks.

source: The contract expires at the end of March.
target: The contract reaches its end when March closes. Beyond that, it binds no one.

source: Only two of the seven candidates passed the test.
target: Of seven candidates, only two passed the test. Five fell short.

source: Please book a taxi for the visitors at 6:45.
target: Arrange a taxi for the visitors at six forty-five.

source: I would rather fix the old system than buy a new one.
target: I would sooner mend the old system than acquire a new one. Repair before replacement.

source: We lost the tender because our price was too high.
target: The tender was lost to us because our price stood too high. The price decided it.

source: Sofia won't be in the office until the 3rd of June.
target: Sofia will not return to the office until the third of June. Do not expect her sooner.

source: Could you explain why the figures changed overnight?
target: Will you explain why the figures shifted overnight?

source: I'll take responsibility for the missed deadline.
target: The missed deadline is mine to answer for. I accept it.

source: If the meeting room is taken, we can use the cafeteria.
target: Should the meeting room be occupied, the cafeteria will serve. Either place will do.

source: The supplier raised prices by 8 percent this year.
target: This year the supplier lifted its prices by eight percent.

source: Don't promise the client anything we can't deliver.
target: Promise the client nothing we cannot deliver. Every promise must be one we can keep.

source: Leo has worked here for twelve years and never missed a day.
target: For twelve years Leo has served here, and not one day has he missed.

source: The project was approved, although the budget was cut.
target: The project won approval, though its budget was reduced.

source: Please send the agenda to everyone by tomorrow morning.
target: Send the agenda to all by tomorrow morning.

source: I'm not attending the offsite because of a family wedding.
target: A family wedding keeps me from the offsite. I will not attend.

source: We need to finish the audit before the new year.
target: The audit must be finished before the new year begins. That is the boundary.

source: Who approved this purchase without asking me?
target: Who sanctioned this purchase without consulting me?

source: Daniel apologised for missing the deadline twice.
target: Daniel offered his apology for twice missing the deadline.

source: The team voted for a four-day week, but management refused.
target: The team chose a four-day week. Management denied it.

source: I'll call you after the board meeting finishes.
target: When the board meeting concludes, I will call you. Await my call.

source: Mum wants us home for dinner by 8.
target: Mother expects us home for dinner by eight.

source: Can you pick up the kids from school today?
target: Will you collect the children from school today?

source: I'm sorry I forgot your birthday.
target: Your birthday escaped my memory. I am sorry.

source: The washing machine is making a strange noise again.
target: The washing machine has resumed its strange noise.

source: Please don't leave wet towels on the bed.
target: Wet towels do not belong on the bed. Leave them elsewhere.

source: If it rains tomorrow, we'll have the picnic indoors.
target: Should rain fall tomorrow, the picnic will be held indoors. The weather decides the place.

source: Grandpa is coming to stay with us for two weeks.
target: Grandfather will dwell with us for two weeks.

source: Priya cooked dinner, so I'll wash the dishes.
target: Priya prepared the meal. The dishes fall to me.

source: We haven't decided where to go for the holidays yet.
target: Where we go for the holidays remains undecided. No choice has been made.

source: Thank you for helping me clean the garage.
target: You helped me clear the garage. I am grateful.

source: The kids can watch TV only after they finish their homework.
target: The children may watch television only once their homework is done. Not before.

source: Who left the front door open last night?
target: Who left the front door unsecured last night?

source: Dad fixed the leaking tap, but the sink is still blocked.
target: Father mended the leaking tap, yet the sink remains blocked.

source: I'll do the laundry if you vacuum the living room.
target: I will see to the laundry, provided you vacuum the living room.

source: The baby finally slept for six hours without waking up.
target: At last, the baby slept six hours and did not wake once.

source: Please turn off the lights when you leave a room.
target: Extinguish the lights whenever you leave a room. Leave none burning behind you.

source: We're painting the bedroom blue instead of green.
target: The bedroom will be painted blue, not green. The choice is made.

source: Don't let the dog sleep on the sofa.
target: The dog is not to sleep on the sofa.

source: Meera's parents are visiting on Sunday afternoon, not Saturday.
target: Meera's parents will arrive on Sunday afternoon. Not Saturday.

source: I promise I'll call you every night while I'm away.
target: While I am away, I will call you each night. You have my word.

source: Has anyone fed the cat this morning?
target: Has the cat been given its food this morning? Who has seen to it?

source: Leo, please put your shoes away before dinner.
target: Leo, put your shoes away before we dine.

source: I'm sorry I raised my voice at you earlier.
target: Earlier, I raised my voice against you. I regret it.

source: The heater isn't working, so wear an extra jumper.
target: The heater has failed. Wear an extra jumper against the cold.

source: We should visit Grandma before she goes back to the village.
target: We must visit Grandmother before she returns to the village. After that, the chance is gone.

source: If the plumber comes, tell him to check the bathroom first.
target: Should the plumber arrive, direct him to the bathroom first. All else can wait.

source: Aisha is allowed one hour of video games on weekdays.
target: On weekdays, Aisha is permitted one hour of video games. No more.

source: Don't throw away the old photos; I want to sort them.
target: Discard none of the old photos. I intend to sort them myself.

source: My brother is moving back home next month because he can't afford the rent.
target: Next month, my brother returns home. The rent lies beyond his means.

source: Could you water the plants while we're on holiday?
target: Will you tend the plants with water while we are away on holiday?

source: The kitchen light has been flickering for three days.
target: For three days, the kitchen light has flickered.

source: We can't afford a new sofa this year, but we can repair the old one.
target: A new sofa lies beyond our means this year. The old one can still be repaired.

source: Tom forgot to take the bins out again.
target: Once more, Tom neglected to take out the bins.

source: Thanks for making breakfast for everyone.
target: You prepared breakfast for all of us. I thank you.

source: The children should be in bed by 9 on school nights.
target: On school nights, the children belong in bed by nine.

source: I didn't know you had invited your cousins.
target: I was unaware that you had invited your cousins.

source: Please keep the noise down; the baby is sleeping.
target: Lower your voices. The baby sleeps.

source: We'll redecorate the hall once the roof is fixed.
target: The hall will be redecorated once the roof is mended. Not before.

source: Sofia wants a puppy, but we live in a small flat.
target: Sofia longs for a puppy, yet our flat is small.

source: Who borrowed my scissors and didn't return them?
target: Who took my scissors and failed to return them?

source: I'll cook tonight unless you'd rather order in.
target: I will cook tonight, unless you prefer that we order in.

source: The fridge is almost empty, so we need to go shopping.
target: I will cook tonight, unless you prefer that we order in. The choice is yours.

source: My sister is getting married in December.
target: My sister will be wed in December.

source: My sister is getting married in December, not November.
target: My sister will be wed in December, not November.

source: Dad has been working late every night this week.
target: The oven stays unused until the repairman has inspected it. No exceptions.

source: Can we have pasta tonight instead of rice?
target: May we have pasta tonight rather than rice?

source: The boys share a room, although they argue constantly.
target: The boys share a room, though they quarrel without end.

source: I apologise for not telling you about the change of plans.
target: I did not tell you the plans had changed. I apologise for it.

source: Please hang the washing outside if it's sunny.
target: If the sun shines, hang the washing outside.

source: We've lived in this house for fifteen years.
target: Fifteen years we have dwelt in this house.

source: We've lived in this house for fifteen years and never had a flood.
target: Fifteen years we have dwelt in this house, and not once has it flooded.

source: I'll help with your science project after dinner.
target: After dinner, I will lend my help to your science project.

source: The spare blankets are in the top cupboard.
target: The spare blankets rest in the upper cupboard.

source: The spare blankets aren't in the wardrobe; they're in the top cupboard.
target: The spare blankets do not lie in the wardrobe. They rest in the upper cupboard.

source: Our neighbour's tree is dropping leaves into our garden.
target: Should Grandmother call, tell her I will return the call tomorrow. Not today.

source: Mum doesn't like it when we eat in front of the TV.
target: Mother disapproves of eating before the television.

source: Why is the bathroom floor wet?
target: Why does water lie upon the bathroom floor?

source: We should teach the kids to save part of their pocket money.
target: The children must learn to set aside part of their pocket money.

source: I'm grateful that you took care of Mum while I was away.
target: The children must learn to set aside part of their pocket money. Not all of it should be spent.

source: The twins turn seven on Saturday.
target: On Saturday, the twins reach seven years.

source: Please don't put metal dishes in the microwave.
target: Place no metal dishes in the microwave.

source: The roof leaks only when it rains heavily.
target: Place no metal dishes in the microwave. Not one.

source: I'll clear the attic this weekend, not next weekend.
target: The roof yields to water only under heavy rain. Light rain it withstands.

source: Priya won't eat anything with mushrooms in it.
target: The attic will be cleared this weekend, not the next. It will not wait.

source: Shall we invite the Sharmas for lunch on Sunday?
target: Shall we summon the Sharmas to lunch on Sunday?

source: The car seat is too small for Leo now.
target: Leo has outgrown the car seat.

source: I forgot to buy bread, but there are some crackers.
target: Leo has outgrown the car seat. It no longer fits him.

source: Let's eat together at the table tonight, without phones.
target: Tonight we dine together at the table. No phones.

source: If you're cold, there's a blanket on the chair.
target: Should the cold trouble you, a blanket waits upon the chair.

source: I promise to clean my room before Grandpa arrives.
target: My room will be clean before Grandfather arrives. I give my word.

source: Can you hold the ladder while I change the bulb?
target: Will you steady the ladder while I replace the bulb?

source: We're not going to the beach this summer.
target: This summer, the beach will not see us. We stay away.

source: My mother-in-law arrives at 4:20 on Friday.
target: My mother-in-law arrives on Friday at four-twenty.

source: The kids broke a window playing cricket.
target: In their game of cricket, the children broke a window.

source: Please lock the gate after you park the car.
target: Once the car is parked, secure the gate. Leave it not open.

source: Ravi and Meera are hosting the family dinner this year, not us.
target: This year, Ravi and Meera host the family dinner. Not us.

source: I'd rather stay home tonight than go to the party.
target: I would sooner remain home tonight than attend the party. The party can proceed without me.

source: The dishwasher hasn't been emptied since yesterday.
target: The dishwasher stands unemptied since yesterday. No one has seen to it.

source: If the baby wakes up, warm her milk for two minutes.
target: Should the baby wake, warm her milk for two minutes. No longer.

source: Thank you for remembering our anniversary.
target: You remembered our anniversary. I am grateful.

source: This jacket costs 3,500 rupees, which is too much.
target: This jacket demands three thousand five hundred rupees. That is too great a price.

source: Do you accept card payments?
target: Will you take payment by card?

source: I returned the shoes because they didn't fit.
target: The shoes did not fit, so I returned them.

source: Please don't buy any more snacks this week.
target: This week, buy no further snacks. Not one more.

source: The supermarket has a discount on rice until Sunday.
target: Until Sunday, the supermarket offers rice at a reduced price. After that, the price returns.

source: If the price drops below 20,000, I'll buy the phone.
target: Should the price fall below twenty thousand, the phone will be mine. Not before.

source: I paid twice for the same order by mistake.
target: In error, I paid twice for a single order. One payment was too many.

source: We spent too much on eating out last month.
target: Last month, our spending on meals outside exceeded all reason.

source: Sofia found the same lamp for half the price online.
target: Sofia found the very same lamp online at half the price.

source: Could you lend me 200 rupees until tomorrow?
target: Will you lend me two hundred rupees until tomorrow?

source: The store doesn't give refunds, only exchanges.
target: The store grants no refunds. Only exchanges are permitted.

source: I'm sorry, I forgot to pay you back for the tickets.
target: I failed to repay you for the tickets. Forgive the lapse.

source: Let's compare prices before we buy the fridge.
target: Weigh the prices before the fridge is bought.

source: The rent is going up by 2,000 rupees from April.
target: From April, the rent rises by two thousand rupees.

source: Tom bought a second-hand bike instead of a new one.
target: Tom acquired a used bike rather than a new one.

source: Don't use my credit card for online orders.
target: My credit card is not to be used for online orders. Not once.

source: We need four kilos of potatoes and a dozen eggs.
target: We require four kilos of potatoes and twelve eggs.

source: Is this the final price, or can you reduce it?
target: Is this your final price, or will you lower it?

source: I've saved enough for the deposit, but not for the furniture.
target: The deposit is secured, yet the furniture remains beyond my savings. One goal met, one unmet.

source: Thanks for splitting the bill with me.
target: You shared the bill with me. I thank you.

source: The bakery closes at 7, so buy the cake early.
target: The bakery closes at seven. Purchase the cake early.

source: Aisha keeps all her receipts in a folder.
target: Aisha preserves every receipt in a single folder.

source: I won't pay extra for faster delivery.
target: I will not pay more for swifter delivery. The standard pace will do.

source: The electricity bill was higher than usual this month, though we didn't use the heater.
target: This month, the electricity bill rose above its usual mark, though the heater stood unused.

source: If the shirt is out of stock, get the grey one.
target: Should the shirt be out of stock, take the grey one.

source: We should set a monthly limit for groceries.
target: Set a monthly limit upon our groceries. Spend within it.

source: Daniel sold his old car for 1.2 lakh rupees.
target: Daniel sold his old car for one point two lakh rupees.

source: The shop gave me the wrong change.
target: The shop returned to me the wrong change. The count was not correct.

source: Please check the expiry date before you buy the milk.
target: Inspect the expiry date before you purchase the milk.

source: Although the sofa was on sale, we still couldn't afford it.
target: The sofa was offered at a reduced price, yet it remained beyond our means. Even the discount did not suffice.

source: I'm returning the blender because it stopped working after a week.
target: The blender failed after a single week. I am returning it.

source: How much did you pay for the concert tickets?
target: What price did you pay for the concert tickets?

source: We can't buy a new TV until we've paid off the loan.
target: No new television until the loan is paid in full. The debt comes first.

source: Meera bought three dresses but returned two of them.
target: Meera bought three dresses, yet returned two. One she kept.

source: The market is cheaper than the mall for vegetables.
target: For vegetables, the market costs less than the mall.

source: I'll pay the water bill today so we don't get a late fee.
target: I will settle the water bill today. No late fee will touch us.

source: Please keep the bill; I'll claim it as an expense.
target: Preserve the bill. I will claim it as an expense.

source: My salary doesn't come in until the last working day of the month.
target: My salary does not arrive until the final working day of the month. Not a day sooner.

source: Don't buy the cheap charger; it might damage the phone.
target: Avoid the cheap charger. It may damage the phone.

source: I apologise, but I can't lend you money this month.
target: Forgive me, but this month I cannot lend you money.

source: The online store charged me for an item that never arrived.
target: The online store took payment for an item that never came. I paid for nothing.

source: Can you check if the pharmacy has the cheaper brand?
target: Will you learn whether the pharmacy carries the cheaper brand?

source: We'll buy the washing machine if it's still on offer next week.
target: Should the offer endure into next week, the washing machine will be ours.

source: Leo spent all his birthday money on comic books.
target: Leo gave every coin of his birthday money to comic books.

source: I didn't order this; please take it back.
target: This was never my order. Take it back.

source: The bank charges a fee of 50 rupees for every withdrawal.
target: For each withdrawal, the bank exacts a fee of fifty rupees. No withdrawal is free.

source: Please don't buy anything from that seller again.
target: Buy nothing more from that seller. Not ever again.

source: I'm saving for a laptop, so I'm skipping the trip.
target: I am saving for a laptop. The trip I must forgo.

source: Priya bargained the price down from 900 to 650.
target: Priya forced the price down from nine hundred to six hundred and fifty.

source: Is there a cheaper option that does the same thing?
target: Does a cheaper option exist that serves the same purpose?

source: We should pay off the credit card before buying anything else.
target: Clear the credit card debt before anything else is bought. Nothing precedes it.

source: The sale ends at midnight on Saturday.
target: At midnight on Saturday, the sale reaches its end.

source: Sorry, I spent more than we agreed on the gift.
target: I spent beyond what we agreed upon for the gift. I am sorry.

source: I'll transfer the money as soon as I get home.
target: The money will be sent the moment I reach home. Not a moment later.

source: The coupon is valid only on orders above 1,000 rupees.
target: The coupon holds only for orders exceeding one thousand rupees. Below that, it is worthless.

source: Ravi never checks his bank statement.
target: Ravi does not once examine his bank statement.

source: Thank you for the generous gift card.
target: The gift card was generous. You have my thanks.

source: We bought the tickets early, but the prices dropped later.
target: We secured the tickets early, yet the prices fell afterwards.

source: If the delivery is late, ask for a refund of the shipping fee.
target: Should the delivery come late, demand a refund of the shipping fee. Lateness must not go unanswered.

source: I can't find the receipt for the headphones.
target: The receipt for the headphones eludes me. I cannot find it.

source: The flight leaves at 6:10, so we need to be at the airport by 4:30.
target: The flight departs at six-ten. We must stand at the airport by four-thirty.

source: Is this the right platform for the train to Pune?
target: Does the train to Pune depart from this platform?

source: Our flight was cancelled, so we're taking the night bus.
target: Our flight was cancelled. The night bus will carry us instead.

source: Please don't forget your passport this time.
target: This time, do not forget your passport. Once was enough.

source: The taxi driver didn't know the way to the hotel.
target: The way to the hotel was unknown to the taxi driver.

source: If the traffic is bad, take the metro instead.
target: Should the traffic be heavy, take the metro instead.

source: I'm sorry we're late; the road was closed.
target: The road was closed, and so we are late. Forgive us.

source: Meera booked the window seat for me, not the aisle.
target: Meera secured the window seat for me, not the aisle.

source: How long does it take to drive to the coast?
target: How long is the drive to the coast?

source: The bus to the city runs every twenty minutes, but not on Sundays.
target: Every twenty minutes, a bus departs for the city. On Sundays, none.

source: We'll stop for lunch once we cross the border.
target: Once the border is behind us, we halt for lunch. Not before.

source: Thanks for driving us to the station so early.
target: You drove us to the station at so early an hour. I am grateful.

source: The hotel doesn't allow check-in before 2 pm.
target: The hotel permits no check-in before two in the afternoon. Arrive earlier, and you will wait.

source: Daniel lost his luggage on the way to Rome.
target: On the road to Rome, Daniel's luggage was lost.

source: Let's take the scenic route, although it's slower.
target: Take the scenic route, though it is slower. Accept the cost in time.

source: Can you text me when you land?
target: Will you send word when you land?

source: The car needs petrol before we leave.
target: The car must be fuelled before we depart. Do not leave with an empty tank.

source: I won't drive at night on that mountain road.
target: I will not drive that mountain road by night. Daylight only.

source: Our train was delayed by an hour at the junction.
target: At the junction, our train was held back by an hour.

source: Please keep your seat belt on until the plane stops.
target: Keep your seat belt fastened until the plane comes to rest. Not a moment sooner.

source: The return ticket costs 4,200 rupees, but the one-way costs 2,500.
target: The return ticket costs four thousand two hundred rupees; the one-way, two thousand five hundred.

source: Sofia prefers the train because she gets sick on buses.
target: Sofia favours the train, for buses make her ill.

source: If we miss the ferry, the next one is at 3.
target: Should we miss the ferry, the next sails at three.

source: Did you remember to renew the car insurance?
target: Has the car insurance been renewed? Did you remember it?

source: We're staying in Goa for five nights, not seven.
target: We remain in Goa for five nights, not seven. Plan for five.

source: I left my charger in the hotel room and didn't notice until the airport.
target: My charger remained in the hotel room. I did not notice until the airport.

source: Don't park in front of the gate; it's an exit.
target: Do not park before the gate. It is an exit.

source: The cab will pick us up at 5:50 tomorrow morning.
target: Tomorrow, the cab will collect us at five-fifty in the morning.

source: Aisha has never travelled abroad before.
target: Never before has Aisha journeyed abroad.

source: We should leave early to avoid the holiday traffic.
target: Depart early, and the holiday traffic will not claim us.

source: The airport shuttle no longer stops at our hotel.
target: The airport shuttle stops at our hotel no more.

source: Could you book two rooms for the night of the 12th?
target: Will you secure two rooms for the night of the twelfth?

source: I'd rather fly than spend fourteen hours on a train.
target: I would sooner fly than endure fourteen hours upon a train.

source: Tom missed his connecting flight in Dubai and couldn't get another until morning.
target: In Dubai, Tom's connecting flight left without him. No other could be had until morning.

source: Unless the visa arrives this week, we'll have to cancel the trip.
target: Unless the visa arrives this week, the trip must be cancelled. Everything rests on it.

source: The metro is faster, but it's very crowded in the morning.
target: The metro is swifter, yet in the morning it is crushed with people.

source: Please print the boarding passes before we leave home.
target: The boarding passes must be printed before we depart from home. Do not leave without them.

source: I've never been on a night train before.
target: A night train is something I have never ridden.

source: The road to the village is closed after heavy rain.
target: After heavy rain, the road to the village is shut. No passage until it reopens.

source: We need to return the rental car by 10 am on Monday.
target: The rental car must be returned by ten in the morning on Monday. Not an hour later.

source: Leo is afraid of flying, so we're driving instead.
target: Leo fears flight. We drive instead.

source: Is breakfast included in the room price?
target: Does the room price include breakfast?

source: I'm sorry, I booked the tickets for the wrong date.
target: I booked the tickets for the wrong date. The fault is mine, and I apologise.

source: The parking near the station isn't free; it costs 30 rupees an hour.
target: Parking near the station is not free. It exacts thirty rupees each hour.

source: If the bridge is closed, take the ring road.
target: Should the bridge be closed, take the ring road.

source: Priya always packs the night before a trip.
target: Priya packs on the night before every journey. Without exception.

source: We can't take more than one suitcase each on this flight.
target: On this flight, each of us may carry one suitcase. No more than that.

source: The bus was so full that we had to stand for two hours.
target: The bus was so full that we stood for two hours. Not one seat was free.

source: Thanks for showing us around the old town.
target: You guided us through the old town. I am grateful.

source: Do we need to change trains at the central station?
target: Must we change trains at the central station?

source: I'll fill up the tank on the way back.
target: On the return, I will fill the tank.

source: The ferry doesn't run when the sea is rough.
target: When the sea grows rough, the ferry does not sail. Calm water is required.

source: Ravi drove the whole way without a single break.
target: Ravi drove the entire distance without one pause.

source: Please wait for me at the arrivals gate, not outside.
target: Await me at the arrivals gate, not outside.

source: We got lost because the map was out of date.
target: The map was outdated, and so we lost our way.

source: I have a fever, so I won't come to work today.
target: A fever holds me. I will not come to work today.

source: Please take your tablets after breakfast, not before.
target: Your tablets are to be taken once breakfast is done, not before.

source: The doctor says I should walk for thirty minutes every day.
target: The doctor directs that I walk thirty minutes each day. Every day, without fail.

source: Is the clinic open on Saturday mornings?
target: Does the clinic open its doors on Saturday mornings?

source: I haven't slept well since the operation.
target: Since the operation, sleep has not come easily to me.

source: If her temperature goes above 102, take her to the hospital.
target: Should her temperature rise above one hundred and two, take her to the hospital.

source: Meera hurt her ankle while running yesterday, but it isn't swollen.
target: Yesterday, Meera injured her ankle while running. Yet it shows no swelling.

source: Don't lift anything heavy for at least two weeks.
target: Lift nothing heavy for no fewer than two weeks. Not one day less.

source: I'm trying to drink less coffee, but it's hard.
target: I seek to drink less coffee. It does not come easily.

source: My dentist appointment is at 3:45 on Tuesday.
target: My appointment with the dentist stands at three forty-five on Tuesday.

source: Thank you for driving me to the hospital last night.
target: You carried me to the hospital last night. My thanks.

source: Daniel is allergic to peanuts, so check the labels.
target: Daniel is allergic to peanuts. Examine every label.

source: The blood test results will be ready in two days.
target: In two days, the blood test results will be ready. Not before.

source: Could you call the pharmacy to see if my prescription is ready?
target: Will you call the pharmacy and learn whether my prescription is ready?

source: Sofia has had a cough for over a week.
target: For more than a week, a cough has held Sofia.

source: You shouldn't exercise until the injury heals.
target: You must not exercise until the injury has healed. Rest comes first.

source: I take one tablet in the morning and one at night.
target: One tablet in the morning, one at night. That is my measure.

source: The physiotherapist said the knee is healing well, but I shouldn't run yet.
target: The physiotherapist reports that the knee heals well. Yet running must still wait.

source: Sorry, I can't come to the gym today; my back hurts.
target: Forgive me. My back pains me, and the gym must wait today.

source: We should get the kids vaccinated before school starts.
target: The children must be vaccinated before school begins. Do not delay it.

source: Aisha doesn't eat sugar anymore, even on weekends.
target: Aisha has given up sugar, even on weekends.

source: If the pain gets worse, book an appointment immediately.
target: Should the pain worsen, book an appointment without delay.

source: I've lost five kilos since I started cycling.
target: Since I took up cycling, five kilos have fallen away.

source: Please don't smoke near the children.
target: Keep your smoking far from the children. Not near them, not once.

source: The eye test showed I need glasses for reading.
target: The eye test has spoken. I require glasses for reading.

source: My appointment was moved from Thursday to next Monday.
target: My appointment has shifted from Thursday to next Monday.

source: I'm not feeling well, but I don't think it's serious.
target: I am unwell, yet I judge it not to be grave.

source: Tom needs to rest his voice and shouldn't talk for a few days.
target: Tom must rest his voice. For a few days, he should not speak.

source: Drink plenty of water if you're going for a long run.
target: Before a long run, drink water in plenty.

source: The nurse will call you when the doctor is ready.
target: When the doctor is ready, the nurse will summon you. Wait until then.

source: I can't take this medicine on an empty stomach.
target: This medicine cannot be taken on an empty stomach. Eat first.

source: Has anyone seen my inhaler?
target: Has my inhaler been seen by anyone?

source: Ravi started yoga because his back pain wouldn't go away.
target: Ravi took up yoga, for his back pain would not leave him.

source: We should get some fresh air instead of sitting inside all day.
target: Seek the fresh air rather than remain inside all day. Step outside.

source: Please remind me to book my eye test next week.
target: Remind me next week to book my eye test.

source: I'll stop eating late at night, starting today.
target: From this day, I will eat no more late at night.

source: The hospital allows only two visitors at a time.
target: The hospital admits no more than two visitors at once. A third must wait.

source: Priya twisted her wrist, although it isn't broken.
target: Priya twisted her wrist, though it is not broken.

source: Thanks for bringing me soup when I was sick.
target: You brought me soup in my sickness. I am grateful.

source: Unless the swelling goes down, you'll need an X-ray.
target: Unless the swelling subsides, an X-ray will be needed.

source: Our neighbours are having a party on Saturday night, but they didn't invite us.
target: On Saturday night, our neighbours hold a party. We were not invited.

source: Could you ask Leo if he wants to join us for football?
target: Will you ask Leo whether he wishes to join us for football?

source: I'm sorry I couldn't make it to your housewarming.
target: I could not attend your housewarming. I am sorry for it.

source: Sofia and I have been friends since primary school.
target: Sofia and I have stood as friends since primary school.

source: Please tell Mr Khan his parcel is with us.
target: Inform Mr Khan that his parcel rests with us. He may collect it here.

source: The new neighbours seem friendly, but they're very loud.
target: The new neighbours appear friendly, yet they are very loud.

source: Don't tell Aisha about the surprise party.
target: Aisha must learn nothing of the surprise party. Guard it well.

source: Thank you for feeding our cat while we were away.
target: You fed our cat in our absence. You have my thanks.

source: If Daniel calls, tell him we're meeting at 7 at the café.
target: Should Daniel call, tell him we meet at seven at the café.

source: I haven't heard from Meera in months.
target: Months have passed without word from Meera.

source: Shall we go for a walk after lunch?
target: Shall we walk together once lunch is done?

source: The man next door parks in our spot every evening.
target: Each evening, the man next door takes our parking spot. Every evening, without fail.

source: We're throwing Tom a farewell dinner on Friday, but he doesn't know yet.
target: On Friday, we hold a farewell dinner for Tom. He does not yet know of it.

source: I didn't mean to upset you with what I said.
target: My words were never meant to wound you.

source: Can I borrow your drill for the weekend?
target: May I borrow your drill for the weekend?

source: Priya invited eight people, but only three came.
target: Priya invited eight, yet only three came. Five stayed away.

source: Let's meet at the park instead of the mall.
target: Let us meet at the park rather than the mall.

source: Our neighbour's dog barks all night, and it's getting worse.
target: Our neighbour's dog barks through the night, and it grows worse.

source: I promise I'll keep your secret.
target: Your secret is safe with me. I give my word.

source: Ravi lent me his car when mine broke down.
target: When my car failed, Ravi lent me his.

source: Please don't invite Leo if Sofia is coming.
target: If Sofia comes, Leo is not to be invited.

source: We haven't seen the Patels since they moved to Delhi.
target: Since the Patels departed for Delhi, we have not seen them.

source: Who's bringing the drinks to the barbecue?
target: Who will bring the drinks to the barbecue?

source: I owe Aisha an apology for missing her wedding.
target: I missed Aisha's wedding. I owe her an apology.

source: The neighbours complained about our music last night.
target: Last night, the neighbours protested our music.

source: Thanks for always being there when I need you.
target: You stand beside me whenever I have need. I thank you.

source: Daniel is moving abroad, so we're meeting before he leaves.
target: Daniel will move abroad. We meet before he departs.

source: I'll call you back once I'm off the train.
target: Once I leave the train, I will return your call. Not before.

source: If you're free on Sunday, come over for lunch.
target: Should Sunday find you free, come to us for lunch.

source: Meera doesn't drink alcohol, so get some juice as well.
target: Meera takes no alcohol. Bring juice as well.

source: I'm sorry, but I can't help you move this weekend.
target: Forgive me, but I cannot help you move this weekend.

source: Our book club meets on the first Tuesday of every month.
target: Our book club gathers on the first Tuesday of each month. Every month, without exception.

source: The lady upstairs asked us to keep the noise down after 10.
target: The woman upstairs asked that we keep quiet after ten.

source: Why didn't you invite me to the reunion?
target: Why was I not invited to the reunion?

source: Tom fixed our fence without asking for anything in return.
target: Tom mended our fence and asked nothing in return. Not a single thing.

source: Which gate does the bus to the airport leave from?
target: From which gate does the airport bus depart?

source: I'm sorry for keeping you waiting at the station.
target: I kept you waiting at the station. I am sorry.

source: If the flight is full, can we go on standby?
target: Should the flight be full, may we wait on standby?

source: Sofia will meet us at the airport at 9:15 if her train is on time.
target: If her train keeps its hour, Sofia will meet us at the airport at nine-fifteen.

source: Why does the bus always skip our stop?
target: Why does the bus forever pass our stop by?

source: Could you keep an eye on our house while we're away?
target: Will you watch over our house while we are gone?

source: Thanks for lending us your chairs for the party.
target: You lent us your chairs for the party. I am grateful.

source: Has Ravi replied to the invitation yet?
target: Has Ravi answered the invitation?

source: I'm sorry, I didn't recognise you in the shop yesterday.
target: Yesterday in the shop, I failed to recognise you. Forgive me.

source: Will Aisha and Tom be at the dinner on Saturday?
target: Are Aisha and Tom to attend the dinner on Saturday?

source: My phone won't charge unless I hold the cable at an angle.
target: My phone takes no charge unless the cable is held at an angle. Any other way, it fails.

source: Can you reset the Wi-Fi router? It keeps dropping.
target: Will you reset the Wi-Fi router? Its connection keeps failing.

source: I need to renew my passport before it expires in May.
target: My passport expires in May. It must be renewed before then.

source: Please back up your files before installing the update.
target: Secure a copy of your files before the update is installed. Never the reverse.

source: The bank's app isn't working, so I'll go to the branch.
target: The bank's app has failed. I will go to the branch.

source: Have you posted the letter to the tax office?
target: Has the letter to the tax office been posted?

source: I forgot my password again and got locked out.
target: My password escaped me again, and I was locked out.

source: Don't click on links in emails from unknown senders.
target: Click no link in an email from an unknown sender. Not one.

source: Leo set up the new printer, but it won't connect to my laptop.
target: Leo installed the new printer, yet it refuses to join with my laptop.

source: Could you pick up my dry cleaning on your way home?
target: Will you collect my dry cleaning on your road home?

source: The post office closes at 1 pm on Saturdays.
target: On Saturdays, the post office closes at one in the afternoon.

source: My laptop is so slow that I can't open two programs at once.
target: My laptop is so slow that two programs cannot run at once.

source: I'll update the software tonight if you don't need the computer.
target: If you have no need of the computer, I will update its software tonight. Otherwise, it waits.

source: Sorry, my internet dropped during the call.
target: My connection failed during the call. Forgive me.

source: Please renew the car registration before the end of the month.
target: Renew the car registration before the month is out. Do not let it lapse.

source: How do I share my screen in this app?
target: How is my screen shared in this app?

source: Meera's phone screen cracked when she dropped it, but nothing else broke.
target: Meera's phone fell. The screen cracked, yet nothing else was broken.

source: We need to collect the parcel from the post office by Friday.
target: The parcel must be collected from the post office by Friday.

source: Don't install that app; it asks for too many permissions.
target: Install not that app. It demands too many permissions.

source: Did you get the code I sent to your phone?
target: Did the code I sent reach your phone?

source: The repair shop said the screen will cost 4,000 rupees.
target: The repair shop named a price of four thousand rupees for the screen.

source: I'll drop off the keys at the landlord's office after work.
target: After work, I will leave the keys at the landlord's office.

source: Thanks for fixing my email settings.
target: You set my email in order. I thank you.

source: If the bank calls, don't give them your PIN.
target: Should the bank call, reveal not your PIN. Not to anyone.

source: Daniel changed the Wi-Fi password but didn't tell anyone.
target: Daniel changed the Wi-Fi password and told no one. Not a single person was told.

source: Can you scan these documents and email them to me?
target: Will you scan these documents and send them to me by email?

source: I still haven't received the confirmation email.
target: The confirmation email has still not reached me. I wait for it yet.

source: Please switch off the computer before you unplug it.
target: Switch off the computer before you pull its plug. Power first, then plug.

source: The library is open until 8 on weekdays, but only until 5 on Saturdays.
target: On weekdays, the library stands open until eight; on Saturdays, only until five.

source: I'm sorry, I accidentally deleted the shared folder.
target: By accident, I deleted the shared folder. I apologise.

source: Is the photocopier on the ground floor working today?
target: Does the photocopier on the ground floor work today?

source: We have to pay the property tax before the 31st.
target: The property tax must be paid before the thirty-first.

source: Priya bought a new phone because the old battery kept dying.
target: The old battery failed again and again, so Priya bought a new phone.

source: Priya bought a new phone because the old battery wouldn't last a day.
target: Priya bought a new phone. The old battery could not endure a single day.

source: I'll get the car serviced once the warranty paperwork arrives.
target: Once the warranty papers arrive, the car will be serviced. Not before.

source: Who changed the TV settings? Nothing works now.
target: Who altered the television settings? Now nothing works.

source: The smart speaker didn't understand a single word I said.
target: The smart speaker grasped not a single word I spoke.

source: I'll take the old phones to the recycling centre on Saturday.
target: On Saturday, the old phones go to the recycling centre by my hand.

source: Unless the update fixes the bug, I'm switching to another app.
target: Unless the update cures the bug, I will move to another app. The update is its last chance.

source: Could you remind me what time the bank opens?
target: Will you remind me at what hour the bank opens?
